global_alternative.rejected_because: birth seed spread exceeds the declared band width, so one global multiplier cannot put every seed in band

dose_feasibility.adam_scale_invariance: step size is set by lr, not by gradient magnitude, so the focus loss's larger W_q credit does not enlarge the reachable W_q norm

withdrawn_proxy.name: one-step answer_mass delta sign
withdrawn_proxy.status: withdrawn as a verdict criterion; readings kept as descriptive
withdrawn_proxy.why_invalid: a single 1%-relative gradient step moves answer mass by ~1e-3 against a 0.125 -> 1.0 gap that 384 updates must cover, so the ruler has no range to decide movability; and the sign is not forced positive because for softmax attention d(answer_mass)/d(logit_j) = a_j*(span_j - answer_mass), so flattening an in-span peak leaks mass outside the span
withdrawn_proxy.evidence: the analytic first-order prediction agrees with the measured delta in sign and magnitude on every row (see instrument_checks.finite_difference_matches_first_order), so the negative reading is the objective's geometry, not a broken measurement
withdrawn_proxy.replaced_by: same-face, same-denominator W_q gradient credit: focus loss vs task CE

supervision_disclosure.target: queried-entity colour mass per column, normalised (oracle_soft)
supervision_disclosure.source: frozen encoding unit-input-column-color-v1, train scene's own rgb channel
supervision_disclosure.unit_prelabeling: none: loss is a training signal, not an architectural label

revision_history.v4_addition: dose-feasibility gate: a generous upper bound on the W_q norm growth the frozen lr/update count can reach, anchored to r1's measured relative change; this is an ADDITIONAL necessary condition, not a relaxation of any threshold
revision_history.estimator_changed: global multiplier -> per-seed multiplier, both train-only
revision_history.reason: v1 measured a birth logit-range spread across seeds wider than the declared band, so no single global multiplier can satisfy the band for every seed; the band and target were NOT relaxed
instrument_defects_fixed: v1: linearity test used the 6-decimal rounded base range against a 1e-9 tolerance (rounding alone gave ~1e-5 relative error); now uses unrounded values
v1: underflow test included forced one-hot arms whose zeros are by construction; now restricted to softmax-produced attention, with a separate check that the forced arms really are exact one-hot

v2: the verdict gated on the sign of a one-step answer_mass delta, a proxy with no dynamic range and a sign the objective does not force; withdrawn and replaced by a same-denominator gradient-credit comparison, with the analytic first-order derivative added so the negative reading is explained rather than published as a capability claim
v2: float() on a requires_grad attention tensor raised a UserWarning; now detached before conversion

capability_scope: design calibration for U.1r2; no capability claim, no training
